description: This file defines utility functions for executing system commands within specific contexts. It provides mechanisms to run commands as a certain user and to capture their output, encapsulating command execution in the Go programming language.

methods.name: NewAsUserExecContext
methods.description: Creates an execution context that runs commands as a specified user, wrapping an existing ExecContext.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command within a given execution context and returns its standard output, including error details if it fails.
